workarounds.symptom: [Data] `to_pandas()` returns another row's value or raises for null rows in tensor columns
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Data] Keep tensor columns with null rows mergeable across blocks. Target files: python/ray/data/_internal/arrow_block.py, python/ray/data/_internal/arrow_ops/transform_pyarrow.py, python/ray/data/_internal/tensor_extensions/arrow.py. A batch that spans blocks whose tensor column is null in one of them fails with "Trying to unify unsupported tensor type: null".
